metadata.name: Campus building entrance approaches
metadata.method: Explicit source doorway inventory; provisional open-area approaches inferred from campusmap.png under user campus walkability guidance. Visibility paths avoid OSM building footprints, mapped fences/walls and streams. Missing or dated geometry still needs review.

modoc.reason: Dashed yard fence follows the supplied plan perimeter. Openings are limited to the existing north and southwest gate nodes; no playground/sandbox crossing.

acker.reason: OSM Physical Education footprint fills the open courtyard west of the narrow Acker annex. Use source-shown locker block and narrow annex walls for entrance approach checks, not the filled OSM outline.

ayres.reason: Dated OSM outline fills the exterior gap north of studio 120; use PDF main outline and separate studio outline to preserve the source-shown exterior doors. North court remains enclosed; lower courtyard paths retain source graph edges.

metadata.accessibility: Unknown. No accessible flag is inferred from indoor AO markings.
